sentences: The tech giant's Creative Agent now drives assistants in After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign and Frame.io, with Plan Mode in Firefly letting creators approve an agent's plan first.

Adobe has brought AI agents into After Effects, Premiere and the rest of its Creative Cloud tools, unveiling a wave of agentic features, new Firefly capabilities and expanded partnerships at Adobe MAX 2026 in Miami Beach.
The updates let artists hand off complex, multi-step jobs to an assistant that works at their direction, while they keep the final say on the result.
Adobe's Creative Agent now powers expanded AI Assistants, in beta, in After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign and Frame.io, plus the beta version of Photoshop.
In Premiere, the assistant can apply effects across every clip in a sequence, track masked subjects through a frame and correct color and exposure for a whole sequence in one pass.

A preview of local MCP integrations will let artists drive Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and After Effects from the third-party AI agents they already use, making changes directly in native project files while layers, vectors, bins and sequences stay editable.
Adobe's tools are also available in Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.

Premiere also gains Color Mode, a new color grading system; a Generative Media Tool that creates video, sound effects, soundscapes and music right in the timeline; AI audio tools, among them Enhance Audio and Separate Crosstalk; and Generative Remove, in beta, which erases unwanted objects from video and fills in the space.

In Firefly, the Creative Agent drives an expanded Firefly AI Assistant, in beta, with a Plan Mode that shows creators what the agent intends to do so they can sign off first, or simply let it run and a Model Selector for choosing among AI models.

Firefly Video brings story-building and video assembly into a single workflow for anything from social clips to short films, while Firefly Design, also in beta, puts illustration, image editing, animation, 3D and print tools on one canvas.
Photoshop adds Relight, for adding and adjusting light, and Generative Restyle, which turns prompt-based edits into adjustable sliders.
Always-on agents, coming first to the Firefly AI Assistant as a preview, will handle recurring background work such as organizing incoming assets and checking quality.

On the partner side, Adobe expanded its collaborations with Google and Microsoft, including optimized apps for Arm-based Windows PCs, and announced a multi-year strategic alliance with The Walt Disney Company .
Following its deals with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group, hundreds of thousands of licensed music tracks arrive today in Premiere mobile on iPhone for personal, non-commercial videos.

"We're powering a new era of creativity where creative professionals and creators at every experience level have the tools, models and agents they need to bring their biggest ideas to life," said Anil Chakravarthy, Adobe president and incoming CEO.
Adobe MAX runs through November 12 in Miami Beach, with keynotes and Adobe Sneaks streaming at max.adobe.com .
Dan Sarto is Publisher and Editor-in-Chief of Animation World Network.
